 NPL: Four teams in action in today’s two matches 
 Nepal News 
 November 9, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 Photo: Nepal Premier League
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Two matches are scheduled for today in the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 The Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) said Karnali Yaks will face Pokhara Avengers at 12:30 p.m., followed by Kathmandu Gorkhas against Chitwan Rhinos at 5:00 p.m.
 Both games will be played at the Tribhuvan International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur.
 Pokhara need a win to keep their faint playoff hopes alive. After four matches without a victory, they sit at the bottom of the points table.
 Sixth-placed Karnali have also played four games, winning two and losing two. Kathmandu Gorkhas, who feature in the second match, have been in excellent form.
 Currently in second place, they will be looking to win again and move to the top of the table. Chitwan, meanwhile, will hope to improve their standing while extending their unbeaten run. They are fourth with five points from four matches.
 This edition of the NPL will run until November 21.
